verdict.rationale: Spline documents a Code API, a Real-time API and webhooks, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows API version numbering, version pinning, or a published deprecation policy. File Version History tracks scene file states, not API versions, so it is an adjacent feature and earns no credit, and the probe found no OpenAPI spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
